description: This file contains the implementation of a durable list data structure that supports persistent logging and versioning for state machine replication, including interface and class definitions, serialization logic, and command processing.

classes.name: DurableList<T>
classes.description: A durable, versioned list implementing IDurableList<T> with persistent storage and command log replay capabilities.

classes.name: IDurableCollectionDebugView<T>
classes.description: A debug view class providing a visual representation of the collection items for debugging purposes.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the list, applies the change, and logs the command.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the list, applies the change, and logs the command.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the list.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the elements to an array starting at a particular index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the list.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of the specified item.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an item at a specified index, applies change, and logs.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of an item, applies change, and logs.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the item at a specified index, applies change, and logs.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to modify internal state during log replay.

methods.name: ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Handles snapshot restoration from log data.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the list (not implemented).
